name: Clapping
overview: Scripture portrays clapping as an expression of both praise and judgment. In Psalms, clapping is a joyful response to God's triumph and creative power, as seen when the psalmist calls all people to clap their hands and when nature itself is described as clapping with joy. Conversely, in Job, clapping can signify derision and rebellion against God, highlighting its varied symbolic use. While the Psalms encourage lifting hands and musical praise in the sanctuary, the context of clapping in worship underscores a heartfelt, exuberant celebration of God's holiness and majesty.
